text: A Needs you card reads whole on a phone, and says a pull request can merge only when a person can merge it as it stands (#889). Found while checking, before the owner acted from it, that everything waiting on him shows properly. Under 560 pixels a card is one column, and written 1fr it was at least as wide as its longest word, so a plan whose summary names a file had a column wider than its card and every line of it ended a few letters short: both plans waiting to be ratified read that way. A card's column is now never wider than the card, and a word too long for a line breaks. D-0443's line about a failed build's pull request ended 'and it can merge' whenever GitHub found no conflict, of a draft and of one CI's gate had failed. It now says that only of one that's open, ready for review, past the gate and without conflicts, and of any other that it doesn't conflict with its base.
